body:
Quoted from a recent newspaper story:

TEMPERAMENTAL TRACKERS
"Pursuing keys to happiness, researchers look for genes.
by Faye Flam

"Univ. of MInnesota researchers published a study showing that identical 
twins were more likely to report similar levels of happiness than 
fraternal twins...enthusiasts say they will soon isolate the genes 
responsible for the identical twins' similar dispositions and by finding 
out what such genes do, develop precision mood drugs--designer versions 
of Prozac...everyone will be happier," says geneticist Dean Hamer of 
NIH..."

The "rambling and incoherent" Manifesto says:
145. Imagine a society that subjects people to conditions that make them 
terribly unhappy, then gives them the drugs to take away their 
unhappiness."
151. Whereas formerly the limits of human endurance have imposed limits 
on the development of societies...industrial tech. society will be able 
to pass those limits by modifying human beings, whether by psychological 
methods or biological methods or both."
